title: I wish some man or other would take me sometime when hes there and kiss me in his arms theres nothing like a kiss long and hot down to your soul almost paralyses you
html_source: Molly wants sexual satisfaction from ‘some man’. Boylan could be anyone. She wants Bloom to see it in order to satiate her lust and to make him jealous so he’ll satiate her lust too (Norris, M. Virgin and Veteran Readings of Ulysses, p240).
